verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents note templates, saved prompts, or meeting-type-specific summary formats in Fellow. The only related material is developer building blocks: API access for passing transcripts to an external LLM for tailored recaps, and endpoints for writing note agendas. These earn no credit toward the product's own templating capability.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format
